snippet.title: Banchou Tactics: Lion Heart - Announcement Trailer | PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2
snippet.description:
Itsara Amata x Corecell presents Banchou Tactics: Lion Heart, an indie action tactical RPG set in the fierce world of rival Japanese delinquent schools.

Planned for release on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Nintendo Switch 2, the game blends tactical decision-making with dynamic action-timing combat. Plan your moves, position your allies, and master the timing of punches, kicks, guards, counters, and special attacks to win each battle.

Players will fight alongside memorable allies, challenge rival schools, and rise through the ranks in a story of friendship, pride, and the drive to become the strongest.

One school. One rule. Prove you're the strongest.
